title: VTubing: How a Japanese Phenomenon Is Going Worldwide
summary: This article explores VTubing, a Japanese phenomenon where content creators use virtual avatars powered by motion capture technology instead of showing their real faces, and how it has grown from a niche Japanese trend into a global entertainment industry. It covers the technology, business models, and cultural impact of virtual YouTubers.
problem_solved: Enables content creators to maintain privacy while expressing creativity through customizable virtual personas.
why_valuable: It represents a new paradigm in content creation and entertainment that democratizes who can become a public figure while breaking traditional barriers of appearance and identity.
